_README: Payload for `create-xcode-cloud-workflow.sh create`. The script strips this key before POSTing.
Fill the four <...> ids from the discovery subcommands (products / repositories / versions).
VERIFIED API LIMITS — inherited from a sibling project that probed the live API, not guesses:
- ciProducts does NOT allow CREATE. Onboarding the product and connecting the SCM provider
is GUI-only (Xcode > Integrate > Create Workflow). This file cannot bootstrap Xcode Cloud;
it configures a product that already exists.
- 'environmentVariables' is NOT an attribute on ciWorkflows: 409 ENTITY_ERROR.ATTRIBUTE.UNKNOWN.
Irrelevant to Kiln today — it has no secrets — but it will matter the first time one is added.
- A TEST action requires testConfig/testDestinations. Omitting it is 409 ATTRIBUTE.REQUIRED.
A BUILD action needs no testConfig.
- Workflows created via the API do NOT appear in an already-running Xcode session. Editing one
from a stale Xcode shows 'this workflow has no actions' and SAVING THERE WIPES THEM.
Restart Xcode, or edit on appstoreconnect.apple.com.
NOT YET VERIFIED — reconcile on first run rather than trusting:
- pullRequestStartCondition's exact shape. The sibling project shipped a branchStartCondition
and its ADR concluded that was the wrong choice; the PR-triggered form below follows that
conclusion but has not been POSTed against the live API. If it 409s, run `versions` and
compare against a workflow created in the GUI, then correct this file.
- destination values for macOS actions ('ANY_MAC'). The iOS values are confirmed.
WHY PULL REQUESTS AND NOT A BRANCH PATTERN (ADR-004): a branch-name pattern silently skips CI
for any branch named otherwise. It does not error, it does nothing — the worst behaviour
available to a safety net, because a workflow that never runs produces no red.
NO ARCHIVE ACTION, DELIBERATELY. Kiln is a lab; nobody installs it from TestFlight (ADR-004).
When one is added it MUST use 'buildDistributionAudience': 'APP_STORE_ELIGIBLE'. The value
'INTERNAL_ONLY' permanently and immutably stamps every build as internal — there is no
promotion path and no undo. The cautious-looking option is the trap.
containerFilePath is repo-root relative. Kiln.xcodeproj sits at the root and is gitignored —
ci_post_clone.sh generates it before project resolution, which is fine.
